# Timber support: two posts and a cap beam (2.5 m wide, 2.4 m tall) with a lantern under an iron bracket.
# Static scenery along the back wall. Up Z, facing -Y.
new
material new Wood --base-color 0.898 0.690 0.514 --no-slot
material new Iron --base-color 0.125 0.157 0.239 --no-slot
material new Glow --base-color 0.984 0.969 0.953 --emission 0.984 0.969 0.953 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name PostL --size 1 --location -1.0 0 1.1
scale 0.2 0.2 2.2
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name PostR --size 1 --location 1.0 0 1.1
scale 0.2 0.2 2.2
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Beam --size 1 --location 0 0 2.3
scale 2.5 0.24 0.22
apply --scale
select PostL PostR Beam
material assign Wood
active PostL
join
rename PostL Timber
add mesh cube --name Bracket --size 1 --location 0.45 -0.05 2.13
scale 0.36 0.3 0.1
apply --scale
material assign Iron
add mesh cylinder --name Lamp --vertices 6 --radius 0.13 --depth 0.3 --location 0.45 -0.05 1.93
material assign Glow
select all
shade flat
export timber.glb
